sampling: Purposive contrasts drawn from the earlier supplied directory; not random or representative of the web
method: In-app browser screenshots, accessibility state and read-only getComputedStyle measurements. Desktop 1280x720; three follow-up pages at 390x844. Temporary viewport override reset afterward.
measurement_notes: H1 is the first DOM h1 with nonzero box and computed display/visibility; not necessarily the dominant visible text or an element inside the viewport.
Measured CSS font-family is a declared stack, not confirmation of the actual glyph-rendering font.
First paragraph uses main p,p in document order. It can select banner copy or miniature product-preview text; do not treat it as the reading-text token.
Normal letter-spacing is preserved as a keyword, not changed to a measured zero.
Screenshots are inspected in-session; image files are not included in this package. No full-site or accessibility certification is claimed.
V03 and V04 have incomplete visible rendering in this browser and are excluded from composition recommendations. V06 supports limited grid/type observations; its thumbnail imagery is not assessed.

Left navigation rail; pink pill-shaped utility controls; introductory prose, oversized asterisk and community photograph. Formal H1 lies below initial viewport; first sampled paragraph is an announcement banner.
